meta.description: Modern React patterns and principles. Hooks, composition, performance, TypeScript best practices.

copy.tagline: 用现代 React 模式和 TypeScript 最佳实践构建组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 React 开发，想提升代码质量和性能
copy.tagline_en: Build components with modern React patterns and TypeScript best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop with React and want to improve code quality and performance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照现代 React 最佳实践来编写组件，包括使用 Hooks、组合模式、性能优化和 TypeScript 类型。它会优先拆分小组件、避免反模式，并推荐合适的状态管理方案。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或重构 React 组件、讨论 React 架构或性能优化时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个可复用的 useDebounce 钩子。
say.note: Claude 会按 Hook 模式提取自定义钩子。

say.text: 这个组件太大了，帮我拆分成小组件。
say.note: Claude 会应用组件设计原则进行拆分。

say.text: 如何用 Context 避免 prop drilling？
say.note: Claude 会解释状态提升和 Context 用法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow modern React best practices for writing components, including hooks, composition patterns, performance optimization, and TypeScript types. It prioritizes small focused components, avoids anti-patterns, and recommends appropriate state management solutions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or refactor React components, discuss React architecture, or performance optimization.

say_en.text: Write a reusable useDebounce hook for me.
say_en.note: Claude will extract a custom hook per hook patterns.

say_en.text: This component is too large, help me split it.
say_en.note: Claude will apply component design principles.

say_en.text: How to avoid prop drilling with Context?
say_en.note: Claude will explain state lifting and Context usage.
